restrictions: Only replay recorded combat events; never derive hits or damage from the VFX JSON.
Three visual cuts still mean one recorded attack.
Flow/parry appearance is not a guard event; use guard reaction only when the recorded event permits it.
Feint is a trajectory, not a body clone. Heavy is a local impact, not terrain destruction.
Failure, reduced motion, skip and speed changes must not alter combat results, rewards, save or lifespan.
